rule.name: UnsynchronizedSharedCollection
rule.message: This plain collection field (HashMap, ArrayList, HashSet and the like) is changed here without a lock, while the same class shows other threads use it: the change runs in a task handed to an executor, scheduler, thread or CompletableFuture, or other methods read the field under synchronized. Concurrent writers lose entries, readers throw ConcurrentModificationException and a HashMap can loop forever. Use ConcurrentHashMap, ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet() or CopyOnWriteArrayList (for rarely changed listener lists), or take the same lock around every read and write. An exception fits a field that only one thread ever touches.
